content.text:
**Finding: missing — no vendor insurance clause (INSURANCE, preferred target).**

- Searches for "insurance", "coverage/policy/certificate" and "workers compensation" returned no hits; a full read of the definitions and the miscellaneous provisions (Sections 13–30) confirms the Agreement imposes no insurance obligation on TrueLink.
- TrueLink hosts the Client web site and transmits/archives borrower credit data (Credit Data, Client Content), so total absence of cover sits in walk-away territory rather than merely short of preferred.
- Cure: one new Section 31 inserted after the Force Majeure clause carrying only the six preferred elements — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M where TrueLink processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Client, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request. No survival tail, expense or procedural extras were added, and the cyber trigger is drafted broadly rather than limited to the named data definitions. The E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback is offered in the comment.
